findings.title: Forced Apple RAW9 plus Lumen's wide-gamut working space turns all three supplied Sony RAWs cyan
findings.trigger: Fresh RAW with no recipe decoder version, on tested macOS 27 arm64. Apple chooses decoder 8; supported versions are [7,8,9]; Lumen forces 9.
findings.effect: The decoded buffer already loses red, before Lumen WB/tone/color/denoise. A7401502 direct flat v8 mean RGB [0.133833,0.133078,0.122484], v9 [0.033745,0.150265,0.113542]. Pixels with any nonpositive channel rise 0.0685%→43.56%. A7401654 rises 2.73%→74.27%; A7401693 0.261%→79.86%. Lumen WB matrix at default is identity; disabling denoise does not repair the cast.
findings.blindSpot: The fallback verifies outputImage is non-nil, not that pixels retain color. Synthetic render goldens cannot test camera decoder selection. Must compare actual RAW against Apple's per-file default, with rendered pixels.
findings.workingSpaceIsolation: On A7401502, RAW9 is healthy in default/linear-sRGB working space: common Rec2020 readback mean RGB [0.133965,0.138112,0.124154], nonpositive fraction 0.3312%. Linear-P3 yields [0.097522,0.142875,0.117251], 5.2712%; linear-Rec2020 yields [0.033745,0.150265,0.113542], 43.5558%. RAW8 is nearly invariant across the same contexts. Visually verified both RAW9 default and Rec2020 PNGs. This isolates a RAW9/custom-wide-working-space integration failure, not a blanket defect in RAW9.
findings.history: New environment/file-based reproduction at main. Do not generalize to all cameras/macOS versions. Apple's related RAW9/custom-working-space DNG report is a different camera and not proof of an identical underlying bug.
findings.direction: Respect and pin Apple's per-file default for fresh images; retain explicit recorded decoder choices and add these real-camera comparisons. If opting into RAW9, isolate its decode to a validated working space before conversion to Lumen's Rec2020 pipeline, with actual rendered-pixel checks.

findings.title: Point Color picker and selection use different stages after mixer or primaries edits
findings.trigger: Set Red Mixer Hue +100; pick that same red into Point Color; set Point Saturation −100.
findings.effect: At Range 0 the picked color retains C=0.1198007 of original C=.12; at default Range 50 retains C=.0426767. A target sampled after the mixer reaches C≈0. The picker taps before primaries/mixer, while swatches compare after them. Its maskSource option also skips presence and denoise despite claiming S3–S8 (presence consequence source-confirmed, not separately image-probed).
findings.blindSpot: Point-selection tests feed the engine an already matching sample with preceding controls neutral. They do not exercise the actual picker tap after an existing mixer/primaries edit.
findings.history: New extension of previously fixed pre-tone picker-domain issue; that older fix does not cover intra-color-stage ordering.
findings.direction: Define the sample/selection domain explicitly and sample through the stages that precede the selected swatch, or compare membership consistently in a stable source domain.

findings.title: Legal color edits lose substantial accuracy in both preview and export color tables
findings.trigger: Aqua Mixer Luminance −100 on Rec2020 RGB [.3841336,.5959171,.6482891], with all other controls neutral.
findings.effect: Exact color stage remains positive [.106532,.205737,.232635], but 65-cube color stage returns [.202614,.348038,.384925]. Final exact [.127833,.220671,.249249] versus real GPU [.242881,.383300,.422760] at export size 65; max 37.13 encoded-code equivalents. Preview size33 differs by51.21. Global Saturation100 on another positive input gives real GPU65 max31.33 codes. These examples are not merely input-negative clipping; input and exact color-stage output remain positive.
findings.blindSpot: Existing tests pin aliveness/monotonicity or use broad tolerances and sparse patches; cube dimensions are fixed despite narrow chroma gates, hue windows, and skin protection. CPU referenceColor also samples a cube, so comparing GPU only to that reference does not validate the intended exact effect.
findings.history: Known negative-working-channel finish-domain gap independently remains; this reproduces a separate positive-input/positive-exact-output under-sampling failure inside the color-grade cube. General log-table architectural risk acknowledged, these quantitative settings re-probed at main.
findings.direction: Validate exact intended color operations versus the actual GPU across narrow gates and boundaries; consider direct/adaptive stages or a denser/appropriate cube domain. Raising 33 to65 alone is not enough and can worsen an individual sample.

findings.title: Luma curve black lift is discontinuous and makes neutral deep blacks purple on the GPU
findings.trigger: Luma point curve [[0,.2],[1,1]] on black and very dark neutral pixels.
findings.effect: CurveStack.apply(black) stays black; input1e−7 jumps to .033105 linear, violating the plotted endpoint. Through actual GPU, neutral scene1e−8 should be neutral .033596 but becomes [.027359,.006368,.067010] at33 and [.048389,.011588,.117056] at65. The absent zero-luma branch plus existing display zero singularity creates a sharply varying cube field, and GPU trilinear interpolation pulls colored neighboring corners into grey.
findings.blindSpot: Tests check master endpoint pass-through and a no-clipping midtone hue case. They omit lifted luma endpoints at/near zero and neutral GPU equality under lifted black curves.
findings.history: New reproduced finding at main; exact-vs-table errors at this endpoint are much larger than generic float tolerance.
findings.direction: Define a continuous neutral-preserving zero-luma limit and add real GPU grey-ramp tests with raised luma black endpoints.

findings.title: Zone exposure combinations silently flatten broad tonal intervals
findings.trigger: Default pivots, Darks +2EV or +4EV, other zone amounts0.
findings.effect: The monotonic prefix-max bake replaces decreasing requested response with a flat interval. Dark+2 measured1.813EV nearly flat; +4 measured3.894EV. The latter differs from requested mathematical response byup to2.204EV. Scene textures occupying that interval can collapse; the slider still reports a precise exposure amount and shows no limiting telemetry.
findings.blindSpot: Tone six-slider tests prove the separate eased shelf solve. They do not establish equivalent guarantees for Zones; exactColor/referenceColor call direct gain while shipped ReferenceRenderer uses the clamped toneGainLUT.
findings.history: Known open design/accuracy gap: docs24 tone item3 and audit ledger K-040. Reverified current code, not counted as newly discovered.
findings.direction: Use an explicit zone limiter with applied-value/flattening feedback, or signal destructive flattening before it silently changes the requested zone exposure.

findings.title: Uniformity and Point Variance still operate without the texture-preserving local mean

findings.effect: Three input hues24.23°,29.23°,34.23° all become29.23° in the shipping one-argument path. Supplying local mean at29.23° preserves the ±5° texture, demonstrating the unused seam. Shipping all-RGB LUT cannot carry a spatial mean.
findings.blindSpot: ColorScienceTests checks apply(localMean:) algebra but shipping callers only invoke apply(pixel). Passing that unit test does not establish texture preservation in the app.

findings.direction: Add a spatial correction path for those tools or present them as pixelwise color convergence with its texture tradeoff.

findings.title: RAW9 changes mutable nativeSize after downscaled decode, breaking Lumen's preview scale contract
findings.trigger: On supplied A7401502, choose automatic decoder9, decode at target512 using target/nativeLongEdge, then request target2560 repeatedly through AppleRawSource.
findings.effect: After a512pxdecode, nativeLongEdge changes7008→3504. Next2560target requests scale.73059 and gets5120px; next gets2560px/native3504; subsequent cache hits return5120px while native metadata stays3504. Twice the intended decode longedge means4x pixel area, plus incorrect native metadata for downstream consumers. No timing claim. Fresh scale1 and actual native exports remain4672x7008; this is NOT demonstrated export resolution loss.
findings.blindSpot: Synthetic sources expose stable native dimensions. RAW8/7 nativeSize stays7008x4672 through alltestedscale/draftstates. The source reads a mutable platform filter property instead of caching original image dimensions.
findings.history: New macOS27/RAW9 integration reproduction. Root masks observations triggered the check; direct decoder and actual AppleRawSource probes isolated it. All3files original ImageIO/EXIF dimensions7008x4672; fullresolution stillavailable.
findings.direction: Capture immutable original dimensions before scaled decode and use that invariant for native metadata and scale planning. Test source metadata after thumbnail, draft, settled and cached decodes, alongside explicit decoder versions.
